verdicts.reason: A reads as a sensible left-to-right banner with a strong headline, but the bottle almost touches the top and bottom edges. The headline also crowds the two decorative circles, which are now oddly stacked in the top-right corner. The CTA is oversized and sits very close to the right edge, and the body copy wraps into a cramped three-line block. B has the SOLSTICE wordmark colliding with the bottle cap, and the bottle is jammed against the top and bottom edges. Its body copy is tiny and runs into the green circle. The CTA is pushed right, off the headline's axis, and sits half on the circle, leaving large dead areas and a weak hierarchy.
